note: Statuses and acquisition states are recorded from repository evidence (P10C-0 and P10C-A baseline). An edition that is not recorded is 'unknown'; nothing here acquires data.

taxonomies.label: ESCO occupations (v1.2.1, English)
taxonomies.notes: Edition taken from the local dataset directory name 'ESCO dataset - v1.2.1'. Only English labels are held locally.

taxonomies.label: ISCO-08
taxonomies.notes: The local CSV declares ISCO_version = ISCO-08. Codes are zero-padded strings: the armed-forces unit groups are 0110, 0210 and 0310 (the legacy runtime store lost their leading zero).

taxonomies.label: O*NET-SOC (O*NET database 31.0)
taxonomies.notes: Edition from the detected source version. The native O*NET-SOC code is not persisted in the legacy runtime store.

taxonomies.label: US SOC
taxonomies.notes: SOC codes appear only inside BLS OEWS rows; the classification itself is not acquired and its edition is not recorded locally.

taxonomies.label: UK SOC 2020
taxonomies.notes: ONS ASHE rows are keyed by UK SOC codes of one to four digits; the classification and any ONS mapping are not acquired (licence pending).

taxonomies.label: KldB 2010 (revision 2020)
taxonomies.notes: Edition from the local file names (KldB 2010, Fassung 2020). No crosswalk to ISCO is held. Licence review required.
